instruction: Cavity Mask + Invert + Dark-Gray Polypaint Fill The opened `scene.obj` contains a ZBrush Tool whose first (and only) SubTool, named BumpyBall, is a UV-sphere (48 longitudes x 24 latitudes, 1106 vertices, 1152 faces) whose surface has been radially displaced by a sinusoidal bump field. For the steps below, open ZBrush 2025 from the desktop shortcut and continue from `scene.obj`. Peaks of the noise field are further from the origin (radius approx 1.1) and valleys or cavities are closer (radius approx 0.9). The mesh has no polypaint, no UVs, a single default polygroup, and no subdivision-level stack above the base mesh. Using the opened OBJ in ZBrush, Use Mask By Cavity to concentrate a mask in the surface cavities, invert the mask so the cavities become the unmasked region, fill that region with a dark-gray polypaint (0.2, 0.2, 0.2), and export the result as `C:\Users\user\Desktop\output.obj` with MRGB vertex colors preserved. The exported `C:\Users\user\Desktop\output.obj` must satisfy: - Exactly one SubTool, still named BumpyBall, with its base geometry unchanged. - Every vertex line is in MRGB form `v x y z r g b`. - The Pearson correlation between a geometric cavity proxy and per-vertex brightness `(r+g+b)/3` is < -0.6. - The median brightness of the top-20% most-cavity vertices is at least 0.3 lower than the median brightness of the bottom-20% least-cavity vertices.

command:
import ctypes, time
user32 = ctypes.windll.user32
EnumWindowsProc = ctypes.WINFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_bool, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p)
EnumChildProc = ctypes.WINFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_bool, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p)
def close_error():
    wins = []
    def wcb(hwnd, lparam):
        buf = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(512)
        user32.GetWindowTextW(hwnd, buf, 512)
        if 'ZHomePage.exe' in buf.value and 'System Error' in buf.value:
            wins.append(hwnd)
        return True
    user32.EnumWindows(EnumWindowsProc(wcb), 0)
    for hwnd in wins:
        buttons = []
        def ccb(ch, lparam):
            text = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(128)
            cls = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(128)
            user32.GetWindowTextW(ch, text, 128)
            user32.GetClassNameW(ch, cls, 128)
            if text.value == 'OK' or cls.value == 'Button':
                buttons.append(ch)
            return True
        user32.EnumChildWindows(hwnd, EnumChildProc(ccb), 0)
        for ch in buttons:
            user32.SendMessageW(ch, 0x00F5, 0, 0)
time.sleep(95)
for _ in range(4):
    close_error()
    time.sleep(2)
